rv.q: But I can absolutely assert this: The resemblance in all ways between the superb Kourtis and Kushner is so close as to be creepy. Kourtis is a dead-ringer for the playwright in his youth. I kept staring at him, marveling at how this play had been cast with top-tier Chicago actors.
For a play that's inspired so completely by a previous one, this is a surprisingly inspired and even epic work.
This work is inventive and never boring, but this story needs more refinement.
The depths of its script are right up there with James Lapine and Stephen Sondheim’s Sunday in the Park with George or Jonthan Larson’s Tick Tick Boom .
West conjures up an engaging fantasia! Director Jonathan Berry masterfully orchestrates the telling of this fever dream.
